artworks.title: Thomas Cavendish
artworks.description: The image shows a historical figure from the torso up, facing slightly to the left with a forward gaze. The person has detailed facial features with a mustache and short, curly hair. He is dressed in an intricate garment with a high collar and decorative elements. Over his shoulder rests a fabric or shawl. In his left hand, he holds dividers pointing toward one of the two globes he is holding, his right hand rests on another globe. In the background, there is an arm holding a laurel wreath, and on the right, a coat of arms. The scene includes seafaring ships and map labels. At the bottom of the image, text identifies the individual as Captain Thomas Cavendish Esquire, accompanied by a verse.

artworks.title: Jacob Cats
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, centered within an oval frame. The man is positioned slightly to the side but faces forward, making eye contact with the viewer. He has a full head of wavy hair that curls slightly at the ends and a distinctive mustache. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and focused gaze. He is wearing a high, ruffled collar typical of the period, along with a fur-trimmed garment. Around him is an engraved frame with inscriptions, and the background is filled with fine lines that add texture to the engraving. Below the portrait, there is a block of text written in an ornate script.

artworks.title: Jacob Cats, Poet
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man, depicted in an oval frame. He is positioned facing slightly to his right while looking directly at the viewer. He has a mustache and a pointed beard with moderately long, wavy hair. The man is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the era and a fur-trimmed coat. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. The background consists of a textured engraved pattern, and the oval frame bears an inscription with the name "IACOB CATS" and the year designation MDCLXXXV. Below the image, there is a block of text written in a decorative script style.

artworks.title: M. de Cheval
artworks.description: In the image, there is a portrait of an older man depicted from the upper body up. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. His facial features include prominent eyebrows, a furrowed brow, a neatly trimmed beard, and grayish hair peeks out from under his cap. The man is wearing a cap with pointed sides, a ruffled collar, and a rich garment with textured fabric that appears to be fur-lined. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background of the portrait is a simple oval vignette bordered by a band featuring text. The style is detailed and meticulously rendered, emphasizing the subject's dignified appearance.

artworks.title: M. de Chalvel
artworks.artist: Attributed to Karel van Mallery after Daniel Dumonstier
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man facing slightly to his left. He has a solemn expression with detailed facial features, including a prominent nose, expressive eyes, and a beard covering his chin and cheeks. He wears an elaborate hat, possibly associated with ecclesiastical or scholarly attire. His attire includes a high ruffled collar, fur-lined cloak or robe, indicating a person of status. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions and shaded engravings, typical of historical portraiture.

artworks.title: Charles, Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned slightly to the side, giving a three-quarter view of his face. He has a defined facial structure, a prominent nose, full beard, and neatly styled short hair. His expression is neutral. He wears a period garment with a high, elaborate ruffled collar, closely gathered around his neck. The attire features embroidery, buttons down the front, and a medal hanging from his neck. The background has a brickwork design with an arching pattern over the top. At the bottom, there is a cartouche with Latin text.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a person on horseback. The individual is seated upright on a rearing horse, with one arm holding a scepter and the other hand gripping the reins. The person has distinct facial features with a mustache and short, neatly styled hair. Their clothing is elaborate, featuring a detailed, embroidered robe or cloak with a high ruffled collar and patterned sleeves. The person wears a collar or necklace around the neck. The horse is adorned with decorative tack, and both its stance and flowing mane add movement to the scene. In the background, there is a cityscape with buildings, towers, and a waterfront with ships. There are ornate crests or coat of arms and inscriptions in Latin at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Charles I, Prince of Great Britain and Ireland, Duc of Cornwall and Yorck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a young man with an oval-shaped face, deep-set eyes, and refined facial features. He wears a garment with a high lace collar, an intricate cloak, an ornate necklace, and pendant. His hands are positioned in front of him, holding a small object. The background features an ornate border with surrounding text and additional writing at the bottom, along with a coat of arms. The image is executed in a black and white engraving style on textured paper.

artworks.title: Charles Prince of Wales (Charles I)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person from the waist up. The individual has well-defined facial features, including a narrow face, arched eyebrows, and a gaze directed forward. The person's short hair is styled back, and they wear a garment with intricate patterns and fur trim. A lace ruff encircles their neck, and they wear a medallion or pendant. The engraving is enclosed in a circular frame with decorative details and text identifying the person as a high-ranking noble. Small images of books or plaques with text flank the frame. The background features a detailed design, and the outer section includes verses of text.

artworks.title: Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward. He has a mustache and goatee, arched eyebrows, and wide-set eyes. His hair is medium-length and wavy. He wears ornate 17th-century clothing, including a ruffled lace collar and a richly embroidered garment with patterned sleeves. The background includes an oval frame with intricate designs and an inscription at the top. Text below the portrait describes his title and rank.

artworks.title: Charles I on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting atop a horse. The man is in a side view, riding the horse with one hand holding the reins and the other resting on his lap. He has a long face with a beard and mustache, and long, wavy hair. He is wearing ornate armor with a chest plate, gauntlets, and a sash over his shoulder. He has a high lace collar and is not wearing a helmet. The horse is adorned with a decorated bridle and styled mane. The background shows a cityscape with towers and buildings under a cloudy sky. The text identifies the person as Charles I, King of Great Britain.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-length view. He is posed slightly turned with his head facing forward, revealing long, wavy dark hair, a prominent nose, and a slight mustache. He wears ornate attire, including a detailed garment with patterns and a sash. The man is set in an oval frame with decorative borders and the background is also intricately designed. The caption below labels him as Carolus II, or Charles II of Britain.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.artist: Jan van der Vaart after Willem Wissing
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person in an oval frame. The individual is centered, facing the viewer with a neutral expression. They have long curly hair, a prominent nose, and defined lips. The person wears a 17th-century garment with a lace cravat and shoulder armor. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the subject. The bottom of the image identifies the person as Carolus II, surrounded by Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I after Pieter Nason
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a three-quarter view. His right hand holds a baton or staff. His facial features include a composed expression with a mustache and small goatee, and his long, dark, wavy hair cascades over his shoulders. He is dressed in ornate armor with intricate details in the embossed patterns over the chest and shoulders, accompanied by a white cravat at his neck. The armor is polished and reflects light. A sash diagonally drapes across his torso. The background includes patterned drapery on the left and opens to a landscape with gentle clouds and foliage on the right.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I after Pieter Nason
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a three-quarter view, displaying the upper half of his body down to just below his waist. He stands in a relaxed yet authoritative position, with one hand holding a baton and his other arm resting by his side. The man's facial features are finely detailed with a high nose, sharp eyes, and a composed expression. His long, curly black hair falls down to his shoulders, framing his face. He is wearing an elaborate suit of armor that includes a breastplate, shoulder plates, and gauntlets. Underneath the armor, a patterned long-sleeve garment is visible, with a high collar adorning his neck. To one side, a royal crown, orb, and scepter are situated on a table, suggesting a regal context. The backdrop features a textured pattern on drapery and a simple landscape that includes trees and a sky.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.artist: Nicolò della Casa, after Enea Vico
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a grand architectural framework with multiple figures and decorative elements. In the center is a large oval portrait of a man with short, wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a detailed garment and regal jewelry. Surrounding the portrait are statues and figures, including two female statues on either side. One is nude, the other is clothed, holding a tablet. Another female figure at the top center holds wreaths, and additional figures are nearby. The background shows a heavily ornamented facade with columns, decorative swags, floral motifs, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his right. He has an angular face with a prominent nose, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and wavy, short hair. The man wears a high-collared shirt and a richly decorated tunic with intricate designs. The tunic has a lion-shaped ornament hanging from a cord. The portrait is surrounded by a circular frame with geometric patterns and Latin inscriptions. The background is filled with dense, intricate shading.

artworks.title: Charles IX, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a bust portrait of a man, focusing on his head and upper torso. The man is facing the viewer with his head slightly turned to the right. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, mustache, and beard. He is wearing a hat with intricate details and a decorative band. The man is dressed in an embroidered garment with an elaborate ruffled collar, accessorized with multiple strands of beads or pearls around his neck. The background features parallel lines and crosshatch shading, providing depth to the portrait. The image is framed by an oval border with an ornamental ribbon and text below describing the person depicted.

artworks.title: Charles IX, King of Sweden
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body portrait of a man facing left in a side profile position. He has prominent facial features, including a pronounced nose, a full mustache and beard. His hair is short and possibly styled or covered by a laurel wreath. He is wearing elaborate armor with a decorative bow on his shoulder. The background consists of parallel lines and shading, and an oval frame encloses the portrait. Inscriptions on the frame identify him as "CAROLVS IX" and include other Latin text. Handwritten script at the bottom provides further details about his identity.

artworks.title: King Charles Taking Leave of His Children
artworks.description: The image depicts four people in an indoor space. In the center, a man sits on a chair with his legs crossed. He has a long face with a pointed beard and mustache, shoulder-length wavy hair, and wears elaborate formal attire. To his left stands a woman with an intricate updo, wearing a floor-length gown with ruffled details. Two boys are also present - one standing beside the man holding a hat with a plume, and the other leaning against the man, holding an object. The background features classical architectural elements, statues, a soldier, and draped fabric. A table with a covered object is next to the seated man.

artworks.title: Charles Emmanuel I, Prince of Piedmont
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body portrait of a person in a formal pose. The individual faces slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer, maintaining a poised posture. The person has a beard, mustache, curly hair styled back, and wears a detailed ruffled collar. They are adorned in intricate armor with decorative elements, including a large cross emblem on the chest. The surroundings feature ornate patterns, inscriptions, and heraldic symbols, suggesting nobility or high status. The background consists of a textured oval frame with a simple design to emphasize the person.

artworks.title: Charles Emmanuel I, Duke of Savoy, Prince of Piedmont
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man showing his upper body. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has a beard, mustache, serious expression, and styled hair. He wears an ornate outfit with a ruffled collar, fur-trimmed garment, and a medallion on a chain around his neck. The background features an oval frame with the inscription "CHARLES EMANVEL DVC DE SAVOYE PRINCE DE PIEDMONT." Below the portrait, there is a block of decorative script text.

artworks.title: Charles Emmanuel, Prince of Piedmont
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting on a horse. The man is upright, facing slightly towards the viewer's right, holding a scepter in his right hand. He has a beard, mustache, curly hair, and a confident expression. He wears armor with a breastplate, cape, leggings, and boots. There are heraldic symbols in the corners, and two figures below the horse. The background shows a rocky landscape with a castle, people, and soldiers on either side near a river or road.
